body.x: Withings(www.withings.com) unveiled a fitness tracker ‘Withings Go’ at ‘Digital Experience!’ which ran Jan. 5 in Las Vegas. 'Digital Experience!' is an annual event only for media, held by Pepcom before the opening of CES. At the event, more than 1,500 journalists had a time to cover CES opening ceremony and startup products in advance.Withings Go is a fitness tracker to let users know their fitness condition, activity state and sleep state by using electronic ink display. It supports waterproof underwater 50m so that it can be used while swimming and every change is automatically realized through smartphone app to check fitness state. Button-shaped battery and electronic display minimize energy consumption and last maximum eight months without being fully charged.Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.→ Go to 'CES 2016' News page
